stories.title: Hotelier’s son murder accused shot in encounter:SOG officer injured in Ghazipur; Katra gang allegedly killed victim over extortion dispute
stories.summary: A key accused in the murder of a hotelier’s son in Ghazipur was injured in an encounter with the Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force (STF). The accused, Kamlesh Chaudhary, sustained a gunshot wound during the exchange of fire. SOG in-charge Rohit Mishra was also injured after being shot during the operation. The encounter took place in the Kurtha area under Sadar Kotwali police station limits. The Lucknow STF had been camping in Ghazipur for the past two days in connection with the investigation. Just a day earlier, Varanasi Range DIG Vaibhav Krishna had announced a reward of ₹50,000 each for four named accused in the case. See 3 pictures related to the incident- Hotelier’s son shot dead outside hotel The murder took place on Friday night when four masked assailants allegedly surrounded Vineet Rai, son of hotel owner Alok Rai, outside the hotel gate and opened fire. Vineet had just finished work and was preparing to leave for home when the attackers struck. According to police, he was shot once in the hand, once in the waist and twice in the chest. He later succumbed to his injuries. Managing family business after studies Hotel Bindu is owned by brothers Alok Rai and Arvind Rai. The hotel was built on one bigha of land in 2012 and has around 50 rooms. Alok Rai has two sons, Vineet (29) and Aadesh (27). After completing his MSc and D.Pharma degrees, Vineet joined the family business and managed hotel operations. He was also overseeing renovation work at the property. Vineet had married on 18 May last year. Attackers arrived posing as customers On the night of the incident, Vineet was present at the hotel and had dinner there at around 11 pm. As he was leaving for home, he remembered some work and briefly returned inside the hotel. Meanwhile, four men arrived on two motorcycles and approached the hotel gate. They asked the security guard, Shambhu, whether beer was available. When the guard replied in the affirmative, the men said they wanted to purchase 16 bottles. The guard asked them to make payment first. The suspects said they would pay online. Shambhu brought the hotel manager’s phone and showed them the QR code for payment. The men then changed their order from 16 bottles to eight bottles. While the guard explained the pricing difference, Vineet emerged from the hotel and walked towards his vehicle. At that moment, the attackers allegedly pulled pistols from their waists and surrounded him. Two gunmen opened fire According to the investigation, two of the attackers opened fire. The first bullet struck Vineet’s right hand. As he attempted to flee, another bullet hit him in the waist. When he stumbled, the assailants allegedly fired two more shots into his chest before fleeing the scene. Family members, including his father Alok Rai and uncle Arvind Rai, rushed to the hotel after receiving information about the attack. They found Vineet lying in a pool of blood near the gate and immediately took him to the medical college hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Father names notorious criminal Alok Rai alleged that notorious criminal Shankar Pandey and four to five associates were responsible for his son's murder. He claimed that the gang had demanded extortion money from him in 2024. “When I refused to pay, they attacked the hotel and damaged its glass panels and other property,” he alleged. Father had threatened self-immolation Alok Rai said he had previously submitted written complaints against the accused to several senior officials, including the Director General of Police (DGP), the Chief Minister, the Additional Director General (ADG) and the Superintendent of Police (SP). He alleged that no effective action had been taken against the gang. Following the murder, he demanded strict action from the state government and had threatened self-immolation with his family in front of the Chief Minister if the accused were not apprehended. Who is Shankar Pandey? According to police records, Shankar Pandey is a known criminal in the region and is alleged to operate the 'Katra Gang'. Police say the gang comprises several young men involved in crimes such as robbery, extortion and intimidation. Investigators claim the group coordinates activities through a WhatsApp group, where members are allegedly informed about planned criminal activities before carrying them out. Four accused carried ₹50,000 reward each The four accused on whom DIG Vaibhav Krishna announced rewards of ₹50,000 each were- Police said all four had been absconding since the murder. Four police teams were deployed to trace the suspects, while around 12 people were taken into custody for questioning as part of the investigation.

stories.title: UP govt raises maize for MSP by ₹175 per quintal:Families of deceased prisoners to get up to ₹5 lakh compensation; 24 major decisions by cabinet
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government on Wednesday approved a series of major decisions, including an increase in the Minimum Support Price (MSP) for maize, the construction of five new jails, compensation for families of prisoners who die in custody, and enhanced remuneration for government lawyers. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath approved 24 proposals during the Cabinet meeting. A total of 25 proposals were presented. The government also announced that 1,725 air-conditioned electric buses will be operated across 18 cities in the state. ₹1,470 crore approved for five new jails Jail Minister Dara Singh Chauhan said the state government has approved funds for the construction of five new jails. Moradabad District Jail currently houses around 2,000 inmates. A new jail will be built there at a cost of ₹386.41 crore. The Cabinet also approved- Compensation for deaths in custody The Prison Minister said the state has, for the first time, introduced a compensation policy for families of prisoners who die in custody. Under the new provision- The decision has been taken in compliance with directions issued by the National Human Rights Commission. According to the minister, Uttar Pradesh's prisons currently house around 86,762 inmates and remain overcrowded. MSP for Maize increased by ₹175 per quintal Food and Civil Supplies Minister Manoj Pandey said the Cabinet has approved an MSP of ₹2,400 per quintal for maize procurement for the 2025–26 season. The MSP was ₹2,225 per quintal last year, marking an increase of ₹175 per quintal. The minister said the decision would benefit farmers across the state. Maize procurement will take place from 15 June to 31 July. Procurement details Around 150 procurement centres will be established across Uttar Pradesh. Maize procurement, which was previously conducted once annually, has been carried out twice a year since last year. The state has set a procurement target of 25,000 metric tonnes this season. Payments to farmers will be made within 48 hours of procurement. The government said the move would encourage the cultivation of coarse grains. Fees and honorarium of government lawyers increased Finance Minister Suresh Khanna announced a revision in the fees and monthly retainers paid to government lawyers. District government advocates Additional district government advocates Assistant District government advocates Sub-District government advocates Advocate General Additional Advocate General Development authorities to approve rural building plans The Cabinet also approved a policy aimed at resolving disputes between District Panchayats and Urban Local Bodies regarding approval of building plans in rural areas. Until now, District Panchayats were responsible for approving maps and building plans in rural regions. However, disputes emerged in areas where urban boundaries expanded. Under the new arrangement- The government said this would eliminate jurisdictional disputes. Other cabinet decisions Panchayat Annual Report The Cabinet approved a proposal to place the annual report of the three-tier Panchayati Raj system before the state legislature. New Sub-Registrar office in Lucknow Approval has been granted for the construction of a Sub-Registrar office building in Mohanlalganj, Lucknow. A total of 953 square metres of land has been allocated for the project. Funds approved under new city expansion scheme Under the Chief Minister’s New City Expansion Scheme, financial assistance has been approved for Agra, Bareilly and Prayagraj. The state government will provide up to 50% of land acquisition costs for urban development projects. For 2026–27- Cow shelter and hospital in Jhansi The Cabinet approved the signing of an MoU with Dayabhavana Foundation for the development of a cow shelter on five acres of land belonging to the Animal Husbandry Department in Jhansi. The foundation will also establish a hospital for abandoned and destitute cattle. Changes to Semiconductor subsidy framework The Cabinet approved a new mechanism for semiconductor investment subsidies. Under the revised arrangement, the Uttar Pradesh government will first provide its share of the subsidy to eligible investors. The Central government will release its contribution only after the state's share has been disbursed.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Minister Manoj Pandey targets SP, backs bulldozer action against criminals; Delhi hotel fire leaves 21 dead more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day- 1. Delhi hotel fire death toll rises to 21; 17 foreign nationals among victims At least 21 people were killed in a major fire at a hotel in Delhi's Malviya Nagar on Wednesday morning. Authorities said 17 of the victims were foreigners and claimed the building did not have a fire NOC. 2. Varanasi administration demolishes 200-year-old mosque for railway station project The Varanasi administration demolished the Ajgaib Shaheed Mosque in Rajghat shortly after midnight on Tuesday. The action was part of a land clearance drive for the proposed Kashi Model Railway Station project. 3. Self-styled godman arrested in Mathura over rape and extortion allegations IIT graduate-turned-sadhu Abhishek Mishra, also known as Adikarta Narayan Das, has been arrested in Mathura. Police said he is accused of raping a 22-year-old nursing student and extorting money from women followers. 4. DK Shivakumar sworn in as Karnataka Chief Minister; Parameshwara named deputy DK Shivakumar took oath as Karnataka’s 24th Chief Minister on Wednesday, with G Parameshwara sworn in as Deputy CM. Twelve ministers also joined the new cabinet, including Siddaramaiah’s son. 5. Son behind Prayagraj family murders before being killed in jewellery dispute, say police Police have solved the sensational Prayagraj family murder case, alleging that a son killed his parents and sister with a friend’s help. Investigators said he was later murdered in a dispute over stolen jewellery. 6. UP minister Manoj Pandey targets SP, backs bulldozer action against criminals Speaking to Dainik Bhaskar, UP minister Manoj Pandey criticised the Samajwadi Party and defended the Yogi government's bulldozer policy. He said terrorists cannot be welcomed with garlands and praised action against criminals. 7. Film body withdraws non-cooperation directive against Ranveer Singh The Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) has withdrawn its non-cooperation order against actor Ranveer Singh. The decision comes amid the ongoing controversy surrounding the film Don 3. 8. Purvanchal gets first flatted factory; Yogi says 100 industries can operate together Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath inaugurated Purvanchal’s first flatted factory during a workshop in Gorakhpur. He said the facility would allow more than 100 industries to function under one roof. 9. UP government reshuffles ministers’ district responsibilities after cabinet expansion The Uttar Pradesh government has revised district allocations following the recent cabinet expansion. Newly inducted ministers have received fresh assignments, while several senior ministers have been given new districts. 10. UK MP cites grooming gang testimonies in Parliament, reviving national debate British MP Rupert Lowe addressed Parliament on the UK's grooming gangs scandal, reading testimonies from alleged victims. He argued that accounts presented during a recent inquiry should be heard by the wider public.

stories.title: HC seeks timeline over delay in UP Panchayat Elections:Asks government to tell date and orders to submit OBC Commission report
stories.summary: The Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court has expressed concern over the delay in conducting Panchayat elections in Uttar Pradesh and asked the State Election Commission to indicate when the polls are likely to be held. A division bench comprising Justice Shekhar B. Saraf and Justice Awadhesh Kumar Chaudhary observed while hearing a petition filed by Omprakash Prajapati challenging the appointment of Gram Pradhans as administrators. The next hearing has been scheduled for July 10. The court directed the state government to submit the report of the Backward Classes Commission on the next date of hearing and asked the Election Commission to provide the probable schedule for Panchayat elections. Petitioner challenges appointment of Pradhans as Administrators Petitioner Omprakash Prajapati argued that under Section 12(3)(a) of the Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act, the tenure of a Gram Pradhan is limited to five years from the date of taking oath. He contended that by failing to hold elections on time and appointing existing Gram Pradhans as administrators, the government had effectively extended their tenure indirectly, which he claimed was contrary to the law. Earlier, government officials were appointed as Administrators The petitioner further stated that whenever Panchayat elections had been delayed in the past, Assistant Development Officers (ADOs) or other competent government officials were appointed to administer Gram Panchayats. He argued that the same practice should have been followed this time as well. Government order issued on 25 May The term of Uttar Pradesh’s 57,694 Gram Panchayats ended on 26 May. A day earlier, on 25 May, the state government issued an order appointing existing Gram Pradhans as administrators until Panchayat elections are completed or for a maximum period of six months. A Public Interest Litigation (PIL) challenging this decision is currently being heard by the High Court. Earlier practice was to appoint ADOs Panchayat elections in 2021 were also held around three months later than scheduled. The previous elections were conducted between October and December 2015, and the first meeting of newly elected Gram Pradhans took place on 26 January 2016. Accordingly, their tenure was due to end on 26 January 2021. However, due to the COVID-19 pandemic and delays in voter list verification, Panchayat elections were conducted in four phases in April 2021. During the interim period, Assistant Development Officers (ADOs) or Block Development Officers (BDOs) were appointed as administrators. Similarly, when Panchayat elections were delayed by around two months in 2000, government officials were appointed to oversee Gram Panchayats. This time, however, the Yogi Adityanath government opted to assign the responsibility to Gram Pradhans themselves, following models used in Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Uttarakhand. Why was an Administrative Committee formed? 1. Voter list process not yet complete The final publication of the Panchayat electoral roll has not yet taken place. While the tenure of Gram Pradhans ended on 26 May, the final voter list is scheduled to be published on 10 June. 2. OBC reservation exercise underway The state Cabinet has approved the formation of an OBC Commission to determine reservation for Other Backward Classes in Panchayat elections. The commission is expected to submit its report within three to six months of its formation. Reservation arrangements for the elections will be finalised only after the report is received, a process that could take up to six months. 3. Possibility of elections after assembly polls The government is reportedly considering holding Panchayat elections after the Assembly elections. According to sources, major political parties are broadly in agreement with this approach. Why did the government appoint Gram Pradhans as Administrators? Gram Pradhans play a crucial role in rural electoral politics and are often the first point of contact for political parties in villages. They are involved in election management, voter mobilisation, booth-level coordination, campaigning and organising public gatherings. According to the government's reasoning, replacing outgoing Pradhans with government officials could reduce their effectiveness and weaken grassroots political engagement. Officials also believe that village development works and implementation of government schemes could be affected if responsibility were transferred entirely to administrators ahead of elections. For these reasons, the government decided to appoint existing Gram Pradhans as administrators. Pradhan Sangh had also demanded an administrative committee Akhilesh Singh, National President of the National Panchayati Raj Gram Pradhan Sangathan, had earlier said that a delegation from the organisation met Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on 20 April and requested the formation of an administrative committee. The organisation repeated the demand during a meeting with BJP state president Pankaj Chaudhary on 16 May. Lalit Kumar Sharma, Vice-President of the organisation, said that if Panchayat elections are not conducted on time, the state government or district magistrate can appoint an administrator or constitute an administrative committee under Section 12(3A) of the Panchayati Raj Act, 1947. Such a committee can include the Gram Pradhan or a government-appointed chairperson, ward members and Gram Panchayat assistants. Concerns over appointment of government administrators Akhilesh Singh argued that appointing government employees as administrators creates practical difficulties for villagers. He claimed that such appointments increase the risk of financial irregularities. Referring to the 2021 arrangement, he alleged that administrators spent around ₹4,000 crore, but no proper accounting was available. Singh also argued that administrators are often outsiders who are unfamiliar with the local social structure and needs of the village. He said elected Gram Pradhans are more accessible to residents and often provide support in social situations, including financial assistance for families during important occasions such as weddings. According to him, village heads also help maintain local harmony and encourage voter participation during elections through their close ties with residents, a role that appointed administrators may find difficult to fulfil.

stories.title: Bulldozer action at Madrasa after Surya’s murder:850 security personnel deployed; FIRs filed against two Madrasas, power supply cut
stories.summary: Administrative action against alleged illegal constructions has intensified in Ghaziabad following the encounter of Asad, the main accused in the Surya Chauhan murder case. Authorities have begun demolishing an alleged illegal madrasa in the Masuri area, around 15 km from Khoda, using bulldozers. According to the administration, the madrasa had been constructed illegally on government land. Earlier, a bulldozer had also reached Khoda, where Surya lived, before officials shifted the operation to the Masuri area. Heavy security deployed during demolition To maintain law and order during the operation, around 850 personnel from the police force and the Rapid Response Force (RRF) have been deployed across the area. Officials said investigations into illegal constructions and properties are continuing. More than 1,600 people have been verified so far, while authorities are keeping a close watch on suspicious individuals. Two other Madrasas sealed On Tuesday, in the presence of Police Commissioner J. Ravinder Goud and District Magistrate Ravindra Mandad, the Minority Welfare Department sealed two other madrasas. FIRs were registered against three individuals, including the operators of the institutions. Electricity connections to both premises were also disconnected. See 2 photos- Eight bulldozers used in demolition drive Eight bulldozers have been deployed to demolish the alleged illegal madrasa in Dasna. Administrative officials said it is among the larger madrasas in the area and is spread across approximately 18 bighas of land. A large police contingent and senior administrative officials remain stationed at the site throughout the operation. Additional Commissioner of Police (Law and Order) Rajkaran Nayyar said the demolition was initiated after an investigation found that the madrasa in Dasna, under the Masuri police station area, had been built illegally on government land. He said a district-wide verification drive is underway to identify illegal constructions, suspicious premises and criminal hideouts. Action will be taken wherever illegal occupation of land or violations of regulations are found. Surya was murdered on Bakrid 17-year-old Surya Chauhan was killed on Bakrid (28 May). According to a minor friend, Asad allegedly called Surya to a location, where he was surrounded by a group and repeatedly stabbed. The witness claimed that before the attack, Asad asked Surya, “Have you ever seen a goat being slaughtered? Come, we’ll show you.” CCTV footage related to the incident had also surfaced. Khoda police arrested three more accused on Tuesday afternoon. They have been identified as Asad’s father Nawab (45), Farhan (19) and Atif (19). During questioning, Farhan allegedly told police that Nawab had encouraged Asad to kill Surya and had told him to “finish Surya’s story on Bakrid”. Police are continuing their investigation into the murder and related allegations.

stories.title: Purvanchal gets first flatted factory:Yogi says over 100 industries can operate under one roof; plug-and-play boost for youth
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Wednesday attended the joint Kharif workshop of the Gorakhpur, Basti and Azamgarh divisions at the Annex Bhawan Auditorium in Gorakhpur. The programme was attended by senior officials from the agriculture and animal husbandry departments, commissioners, district magistrates, chief development officers, representatives of allied departments and progressive farmers from the three divisions. Addressing the gathering, the Chief Minister said that under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the agriculture sector has witnessed transformative changes over the past 12 years, leading to a marked improvement in the lives of farmers. He said farmers are increasingly becoming self-reliant and are playing a stronger role in the country's growth and development. Yogi noted that incidents of farmer suicides were significantly higher before 2014 but have declined in recent years due to sustained government efforts. He said the state government is spending nearly ₹3,000 crore from its own treasury to provide relief and support to farmers. The government's priority, he added, is to increase farmers' income and strengthen their economic position. Referring to the COVID-19 pandemic, the Chief Minister said the country witnessed the resilience and contribution of farmers during a difficult period. He expressed confidence that farmers would continue to overcome future challenges and contribute to the nation's progress. After the workshop, Yogi inaugurated the Flatted Factory Complex developed in Sector-13 of the Gorakhpur Industrial Development Authority (GIDA). Built at a cost of ₹42.50 crore, the facility offers plug-and-play infrastructure for ready-made garment units and is expected to accommodate around 80 entrepreneurs. The Chief Minister also inaugurated the LIG-EWS residential complex in the GIDA industrial area and dedicated development projects worth approximately ₹208 crore to the public.

stories.title: Groom kept sleeping for 2 days after wedding:Bride finds husband mentally unfit, alleges marriage fraud; Gorakhpur police file FIR against in-laws
stories.summary: A 30-year-old woman from Gorakhpur has accused her husband’s family of concealing his mental health condition before marriage, triggering a police investigation into allegations of fraud, dowry-related harassment and criminal intimidation. The woman claims she discovered the truth only after arriving at her marital home, where her husband allegedly remained asleep for two days after taking medication. Marriage followed traditional Hindu customs According to the complaint, the woman, a resident of the Shahpur police station area, married a man from the same locality on November 21, 2025, in a ceremony conducted according to Hindu customs and rituals. The wedding took place at a marriage hall in Shahpur. She alleged that her father spent lakhs of rupees on the marriage and provided gold jewellery and other dowry items. She said the articles had already been transported to her in-laws’ residence during the tilak ceremony before the wedding. Discovery raises serious questions The woman said her shock began the day after the wedding when she reached her husband’s home. There, she allegedly learned that her husband had been undergoing treatment and taking medication for a mental health condition. According to her statement: • Her husband reportedly slept continuously for two days after taking medicine. • Her mother-in-law allegedly described it as anxiety-related treatment. • She was told he would recover within a day or two. The woman claimed she became suspicious and later photographed a medical prescription belonging to her husband. Prescription reveals hidden condition The complainant said she shared the prescription and sought information from the doctor concerned. She alleges that she subsequently discovered her husband had been undergoing treatment for a prolonged period and was mentally unfit. Feeling deceived, she confronted her father-in-law and accused the family of hiding crucial facts before the marriage. She claimed she told them that both she and her family had been cheated into the alliance. Demand for money sparks dispute The woman further alleged that two days after her arrival, her in-laws demanded ₹3 lakh in the name of her husband's treatment. She claimed that when she questioned the concealment of his condition, her father-in-law responded that even if his son was unfit, the family would ensure her future was secure. According to the complaint: • Her objections were met with verbal abuse. • She informed her parental family about the situation. • The dispute escalated after relatives arrived to discuss the matter. Threats and expulsion alleged The woman stated that on January 18, 2026, members of her family visited her marital home to seek clarification and request the return of her belongings. She alleged that her in-laws refused to return the jewellery, cash and other articles received during the marriage. The family was allegedly told to “do whatever they wanted”. She further claimed that death threats were issued and that she was thrown out of the house. The newlywed returned to her parental home in distress. Her father said the family had spent years preparing for the marriage and never imagined they would face such a betrayal. Police begin formal investigation Seeking action, the woman submitted complaints through the CM Portal, the Delhi Women’s Commission and the Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP), Gorakhpur. Following an inquiry, Shahpur Police registered an FIR against the husband, mother-in-law and father-in-law. Shahpur Station House Officer Rakesh Roshan Singh confirmed that a case has been registered and is under investigation. He said further action would be taken based on the evidence collected during the probe.

stories.title: Yogi govt reshuffles ministers’ districts after cabinet expansion:Key caste equations reflected in new assignments
stories.summary: Following the expansion of the Yogi Adityanath cabinet, the Uttar Pradesh government has carried out a major reshuffle in the districts assigned to ministers. Newly inducted ministers have been given charge of fresh districts as ministers-in-charge, while the responsibilities of several senior ministers have also been revised. New Cabinet Minister Bhupendra Chaudhary has been appointed minister-in-charge of Kasganj and Agra districts. Earlier, these districts were under the charge of Laxmi Narayan Chaudhary, who has now been assigned Aligarh and Firozabad. In another key change, Surya Pratap Shahi has been relieved of Bahraich and entrusted with Basti district, while retaining charge of Ayodhya. Cabinet Minister Manoj Pandey has been made minister-in-charge of Sitapur, a district with a significant Brahmin population. Minister of State Kailash Rajput has been given charge of Etah, where the sizeable presence of Lodh voters is believed to have influenced the decision. Similarly, Krishna Paswan has been appointed minister-in-charge of Kaushambi, a district with a considerable Pasi voter base. Another notable appointment is that of Surendra Diler, who belongs to the Valmiki community and has been made minister-in-charge of Bulandshahr. The move is being viewed as politically significant given the substantial Valmiki population in the district. The last major reshuffle of ministers' district charges was carried out on September 13, 2024, following the Lok Sabha elections. People come daily to watch this not only from Lucknow but from different parts of the state. This film features voice-over by Harish Bhimani, the voice-over artist famous for his work in Mahabharat. stories.title: Son killed parents sister in Prayagraj triple murder case:Accused friend later murders him over loot dispute
stories.summary: Police have solved the murder of four members of a wealthy family in Prayagraj, revealing that the family's son allegedly killed his parents and sister with the help of a friend before being murdered himself in a dispute over stolen jewellery. According to investigators, the son and his accomplice looted jewellery worth approximately ₹1.5 crore from the house after carrying out the killings. However, the two later fell out over the division of the valuables, following which the friend allegedly killed the son as well. The suspect then locked the shop from the outside and fled with the jewellery. He has since been taken into custody and is being questioned. See pictures related to the incident The victims were identified as businessman Virendra Kumar Vaishya (70), his wife Anita (65), daughter Meenakshi (45), and son Abhishek (40). Their blood-soaked bodies were discovered on Tuesday. All four had been bludgeoned to death. The bodies of the husband and wife were found in one room, while Meenakshi's body was recovered from another room. Abhishek's body was found on the ground floor. Investigators also recovered a cardboard sheet lying near the couple's bodies with a message written in red ink that read: "Bunty, Babli and daughter-in-law killed them." Police believe the note was deliberately planted to mislead investigators. Son reportedly angry over being removed from property Virendra Kumar Vaishya ran a gift business and owned a two-storey property at Hewett Road Junction in the South Malaka area. The building, spread across nearly 8,000 square feet and estimated to be worth between ₹10 crore and ₹15 crore, housed 14 commercial units on the ground floor, 13 of which were rented out. The family lived on the upper floor. One of the shops was operated by Meenakshi, who sold gift items, while her father also spent time there. Abhishek ran a business dealing in pesticides and floor-cleaning solutions. Neither Abhishek nor Meenakshi was married. Police investigations revealed that relations between Abhishek and his father had been strained for some time. According to neighbours and relatives, disputes frequently arose over Abhishek's social circle and lifestyle. In one earlier incident, Abhishek reportedly borrowed several lakh rupees from an individual and failed to repay the amount on time. The lenders allegedly assaulted him and briefly abducted him, threatening to kill the entire family if the money was not returned. Meenakshi later arranged the funds and secured his release. The episode led to a serious dispute within the family, and relatives claim Virendra was considering removing Abhishek from his property rights, a move that allegedly fuelled his resentment. Parents and sister killed, bodies covered to delay discovery Police sources said Abhishek and his friend had planned the murders in advance. The two allegedly first killed Virendra Vaishya, followed by Anita and then Meenakshi. After looting the jewellery, they covered the bodies with quilts and blankets in an apparent attempt to delay the discovery of the crime and prevent the smell from spreading. Investigators also found evidence that efforts had been made to clean bloodstains from the floor. Water and floor-cleaning liquid were reportedly used, and oil was later poured onto the surface in an attempt to erase all traces of blood. After the murders, the two men reportedly went to Abhishek's shop. There, an argument broke out over the division of the stolen jewellery. During the dispute, the friend allegedly killed Abhishek as well. Foul smell led neighbours to alert police The crime came to light on Tuesday afternoon at around 3 pm when neighbours noticed a strong foul smell coming from the house and informed police. Upon arrival, officers found that the passage from the ground floor to the upper floor was accessible, but the entrance to the family's living quarters had been locked from the outside. Police broke the lock and entered the property. Inside, they found the bodies of Virendra Kumar Vaishya and his wife in one room, while Meenakshi's body was discovered in another. A forensic team and dog squad were subsequently called to the scene. During a search of the premises, investigators reached the row of shops on the ground floor. One shop was found locked from the outside. When officers forced it open, they discovered another body inside, later identified as Abhishek. The body had already begun to decompose significantly. Younger son had already been disowned The couple's younger son, Ashwini, had married Ritu, a resident of Kydganj, after meeting her online. According to police records, the pair allegedly created fake profiles on matrimonial websites to target and defraud people. In one case, Ashwini allegedly posed as the son of a judge from Hyderabad and cheated a woman out of ₹9 lakh. Both were arrested and sent to prison in 2023. Ritu was granted bail in 2024 and is currently out of custody, while Ashwini remains lodged in Kaushambi Jail. Neighbours said Virendra had become deeply upset with Ashwini's activities and had formally disowned him, severing all ties and removing him from any claim to the family property.

stories.title: Storm and rain alert in 35 districts of UP:Winds up to 80 kmph; heatwave disruption continue
stories.summary: A spell of storms and rain continues across Uttar Pradesh. On Wednesday, the Meteorological Department has issued an alert for thunderstorms and rainfall in 35 districts. Wind speeds may reach 60–80 kmph, along with a risk of lightning strikes. Despite the warning, the state witnessed clear sunshine in the morning with light winds in several areas. However, officials have predicted a possible change in weather conditions by the afternoon. Meanwhile, in a unique ritual reflecting the intense heat, Baba Vishwanath was bathed with mango juice, curd, and Ganga water as devotees sought relief from rising temperatures. On Tuesday, Farrukhabad recorded the highest temperature in the state at 42°C. In Varanasi, strong winds at around 60 kmph triggered a storm in the afternoon. Agra also witnessed nearly an hour of heavy rain accompanied by gusty winds, leading to waterlogging up to knee level in several localities. In one incident, a footpath collapsed, creating a 25-foot-deep pit in the area. Lucknow weather scientist Atul Kumar Singh said- A new western disturbance is becoming active in North-West India from today. By June 5, it will cover the entire region. This may cause scattered rainfall in Western and Eastern UP. Hail may also fall. Winds will blow at a speed of 70 km per hour. Relief from heat will continue. There are no chances of heat waves. Such weather will continue for the next 4 days. Weather forecast for next 5 days in UP June 4: Western UP may see light showers with thunder and lightning. Eastern UP will witness a rise in temperature, with heat intensifying. June 5: Cloudy skies are expected across the state. Light rain may occur at some places. There will be no significant drop in temperature, but relief from heatwave conditions is likely. June 6: Light rainfall is likely in most districts. Humidity will remain high, keeping temperatures largely stable. Heatwave conditions are not expected. June 7: Chances of light rain across the state. Intermittent strong sunshine may increase humidity levels. June 8: Clear weather is expected across the state with bright sunshine. No chances of rainfall.

stories.title: 'Cannot stand with garlands for terrorists':Minister Manoj Pandey speaks on bulldozer action; explains, why he left SP
stories.summary: "In the Samajwadi Party, Lord Ram was abused, Ramcharitmanas was burned, and Ganga Maiya was called a drain. For us, Lord Ram and the nation are more important than politics." These words were spoken by Manoj Pandey, UP's Food and Civil Supplies Minister, who rebelled against SP and joined BJP. In an interview given to Dainik Bhaskar after becoming a Cabinet Minister, he candidly answered every question from leaving SP to the petrol-diesel. Taking a jibe at SP's Brahmin card, he targeted Akhilesh Yadav. He said, “On one hand, Akhileshji says that he doesn't step out of his house without consulting Brahmins, on the other hand, his spokesperson is comparing Brahmins to prostitutes. He should clarify his double standards.” Why has Manoj Pandey, who once opposed CM Yogi's 'bulldozer policy', now become its biggest admirer? And is UP's Brahmin community really angry with BJP? To know the answers to all these questions, read the full interview... Question: You were elected as an MLA from SP, then joined BJP. Rahul Gandhi won by a huge margin in your district. What shortcomings remained, which you will correct in 2027? Answer: When Congress contests assembly elections, its deposits get forfeited on all seats. Why don't you discuss that? Those people who promised to give eight thousand rupees immediately, created hope among the poor and took their votes, they ran away quickly. Now go and see among the public. Lies don't work every day. In 2029, the people of Raebareli will give their result. Question: What was the reason behind leaving SP? Their PDA formula or something else? Answer: What is PDA? I don't even know it properly. They give different meanings every day. Sometimes backward, sometimes minority, sometimes something else... In SP, Lord Ram was abused. Ramcharitmanas was burned, Mother Ganga was called a drain. Manoj Pandey could not accept this. Nation and Ram are more important than politics. Question: How much difference do you see in the working style of SP and BJP? Answer: There is nothing to compare there. Today the world respects Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He gave free ration, water in every household, toilets, housing to 80 crore people without seeing caste or religion. The Samajwadi Party never even imagined these schemes. Question: When you were in SP, you opposed the bulldozer policy, now you support it? Answer: I had gone to express condolences over an incident involving a daughter in Kanpur. I had opposed the method that was adopted there. But one cannot stand with garlands for oppressors and terrorists. Today there is law and order in UP. Yogiji has created such an atmosphere that no goon even thinks of laying hands on a daughter's honor. Even at 12 o'clock at night, sisters and daughters can go out fearlessly. Question: Are Brahmins in UP angry with BJP? Answer: This is the imagination of some people. Brahmins have been the flag bearers of Sanatan and the nation in this country. They have sacrificed everything for the nation. They cannot go with those who point fingers at the army and burn Ramcharitmanas. Brahmins stand with full strength alongside Prime Minister Modi and CM Yogi. Question: SP spokesperson is comparing Brahmins to prostitutes. What would you say about this? Answer: Akhilesh ji should look into this. He says that he won't step out of the house without asking Brahmins, and his spokesperson is giving a different statement. The Samajwadi Party should decide its stand. Question: There are many complaints regarding petrol-diesel in the districts of Eastern UP bordering Nepal. How will you improve this? Answer: As far as shortage is concerned, your statement is not true. There is no shortage anywhere. If there is a minor problem somewhere due to a dealer, that is a different matter. Otherwise, there is no difficulty anywhere. I would request all of you to show correct figures. Now if we take the statements of Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi seriously, then the figures will become wrong. Compared to last year, there has been 10% more supply of oil and gas in UP in May-June this year... We have held a high-level review meeting with officials of oil and gas companies today as well. Strict instructions have been given regarding the border districts of Eastern UP, we are keeping an eye on this... Question: More than half of the petrol pumps in Maharajganj are closed. In Bahraich, a quota has been fixed that they will not give more than 5 liters of oil. Diesel is being given after checking Khatauni and ration cards. Answer: That's right. We will make it even stricter. We supply oil for India, not for Nepal. This year oil supply has increased, but there is also a watch to ensure that oil is not misused and not sold to the border country. Question: How will you address the shortage in Maharajganj? Answer: Today we have reviewed Maharajganj, Siddharthnagar and the entire Gorakhpur division. No permanent problem was seen anywhere. In some places, the dealer did not send money on time, so oil did not reach. There was a problem for a day or two. In the meeting, the Principal Secretary, Special Secretary, and senior officials from all oil companies were present. They have been instructed to review daily and submit reports in the evening. We will review ourselves daily to see how much oil reached which petrol pump. If any problem arises, we will look into it immediately. Question: You have been given the Food and Supply Department, were you expecting something better? Answer: I don't think in that direction at all. Whatever responsibility has been given is the best. According to the Prime Minister's intention, good performance and results as per the Chief Minister's sentiment need to be delivered. So no work is good or bad, whatever responsibility has been given, I will work hard on it.

stories.title: Baba claims to be Lord Krishna's avtar:Accused of brainwashing several young women online, raping and extorting money; arrested
stories.summary: 'Abhishek took my number from Instagram. After that, he connected through Zoom. I became so impressed with Abhishek that I came from West Bengal and started living in Mathura. One day Abhishek said that if I do something wrong with you, what will you do.' This is the statement of Kavita (name changed), the second victim of IIT graduate sadhu Abhishek Mishra. Kavita gradually came to know that the sadhu-dressed person living in Radhakund in the Govardhan police station area of Mathura had sexually exploited several young women. The accused used to call himself an incarnation of Lord Krishna and say that Radharani comes in his dreams. After this, he would brainwash the young women and then physically exploit them. More than 12 young men and women were in contact with the accused. Dainik Bhaskar spoke with the victim young men and women. Read the full report Read the first case sequentially In Mathura, IIT graduate engineer Abhishek Mishra (29) was arrested on charges of rape. After becoming a sadhu, he changed his name to Adikarta Narayan Das. The 22-year-old victim is a resident of Chhattisgarh and is a BSc Nursing student. She stated that Abhishek Mishra gave her drugged milk in the name of prasad, then raped her and made photos and videos. He started blackmailing her and demanded Rs 5 lakh. When she refused to pay, he threatened to make the videos and photos viral. On May 25, the student complained to the Mathura SSP. A case was registered at the police station the same day. On June 1, the accused was caught from his house located in Radhakund. Two young women and a boy were also caught with him. Police found obscene photos of more than 12 young men and women on the accused's mobile. Initial investigation revealed that he used to give online sermons on YouTube and other social media platforms. After this, many people would come under his influence and contact him. Initially, he would talk to people about knowledge and religion, but his targets were educated, wealthy young women working in big companies. Now read the complete statement of the second victim Kavita said- Connected through Instagram and YouTube The victim told that Abhishek took her number from Instagram and YouTube. After that, he connected through Zoom. He used to conduct discourses and Bhagavad Gita live sessions on Zoom. She got impressed by Abhishek through this. She came to Mathura from West Bengal a year ago. After coming here, she started living in a place in the Radhakund area. She was troubled by some household problems. A message came from Abhishek on Telegram. How are you, I said - not well. To this, Abhishek said - he knows. Radharani had told him in a dream. That's why he messaged. After this, Abhishek started telling such things on different days, which increased her trust. When made guru, he talked obscenely The victim said - After these incidents, I made Abhishek my guru. Coming and going to Abhishek's rented house became regular. Here girls stayed in one room and boys in another room. It went well for some days. Religious programs used to take place. One day he sent a text message on mobile. He wrote - if I do something wrong, what will you do. To this I wrote - I will complain to the police. After this Abhishek started brainwashing me. When that didn't work, he threatened, intimidated and started harassing me. He started talking about devotion to the guru. Forcibly brought the girl from Chhattisgarh The victim said, "A boy and a girl from Chhattisgarh lived near Abhishek's house. Abhishek had brainwashed her too. 6 months ago when her mom-dad came to take her, the girl created a scene, After which they left. After this the family members kept counseling the girl continuously. Somehow they took her away from here, but Abhishek went to Chhattisgarh. He forcibly brought the girl back." Now read the statement of the man who was in contact with IIT Baba... Victim said- More than 12 young men and women were in contact Dainik Bhaskar also spoke with a young man who was a victim of Abhishek Mishra. The youth from Delhi said that he was working after completing B.Tech, when he came in contact with Abhishek and came to Govardhan. More than two dozen young men and women were in contact with Abhishek. He had performed their Gandharva marriage, after which he started exploitation. Some girls managed to escape somehow. He specifically targeted well-educated young women working in multinational companies. After exploiting them, he would extort money from them. He would trap boys and girls by creating a network. He would first perform fake marriages with boys and then exploit the girls. I myself have married 4 girls so far. Beat his mother, drove her out of the house The victim youth said - Abhishek's mother was a government teacher in the Odisha government. After retirement, she came to live in Mathura and started devotional practices. During this time, she bought land to build a house, where Abhishek is currently living. Seeing his actions, she started protesting. About 3 months ago, he beat up his mother. He threw her down from a height of 4 feet. After this, she returned to Odisha. Brainwashed 12 young men and women- Police SP Rural Suresh Chandra Rawat said that Abhishek studied at IIT Roorkee from 2017 to 2021. After that, he worked in a company in Mumbai. Then in 2023, he left his job and came to Mathura. Abhishek used to trap boys and girls online. He sexually exploited some boys and girls. A case was registered based on the complaint of one of the victims. After investigation, he has been arrested. 2 girls and one boy were rescued from the spot. He has brainwashed 12 dozen young men and women so far.

stories.title: 200-year-old mosque razed in 22 minutes in Varanasi:Five bulldozers deployed at midnight; 1,000 security personnel on duty
stories.summary: The Varanasi administration demolished the nearly 200-year-old Ajgaib Shaheed Mosque in the Rajghat area shortly after midnight on Tuesday as part of a land clearance drive for the proposed Kashi Model Railway Station project. Before the demolition, ACP Shivhari Meena and other officials inspected the site. Barricades were erected around the mosque and the area was sealed off. Five bulldozers were deployed for the operation, which brought down the approximately 42-foot-high structure. Around 1,000 police and PAC personnel were deployed to maintain law and order during the exercise. Several senior officers, including DCP Kashi Gaurav Banswal, ADCP Vaibhav Bangar and ACP Vijay Pratap, were present at the site. The debris was cleared and removed in trucks during the night itself. Dispute had been in court for two years The Ajgaib Shaheed Mosque and adjoining graveyard are located in the Kila Kohna area near Bhadau Chungi in Varanasi. Members of the Muslim community claim the mosque was around 200 years old. The administration maintains that the land belongs to the Railways and alleges that a shrine was first established on the site, followed by the construction of a mosque and graveyard. The dispute came into focus in 2024 when land measurements were carried out for the Kashi Model Railway Station project. According to officials, the survey revealed encroachment on railway land, prompting the Railways to initiate proceedings to reclaim the site. The matter subsequently reached court, where the mutawalli (caretaker) associated with the mosque recently lost the case. The Railways later issued a notice directing occupants to vacate the land, but officials said the order was not complied with. Following this, the administration carried out the demolition late on Tuesday night.

stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the schedule for recruitment examinations and interviews to be conducted up to September 27, 2026. According to the calendar, the commission will conduct 12 recruitment examinations and interviews for 20 recruitment processes across various government departments over the next four months. Long wait for recruitment processes set to end Many candidates have been waiting for interviews and recruitment processes linked to vacancies advertised by the commission between 2015 and 2025. Recently, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath held a meeting with the heads of recruitment commissions and selection boards. During the meeting, officials were directed to expedite pending recruitment processes and fill vacancies as quickly as possible. Interviews scheduled for key recruitments The calendar includes interview schedules for several recruitment examinations conducted earlier this year. These include- Health Worker (Female) examination held on January 11, 2026 Stenographer examination held on January 20, 2026 Junior Assistant examination held on February 1, 2026 The commission will also conduct physical efficiency tests for candidates selected under the Forest Guard Wildlife Guard and Enforcement Constable recruitment drives. Dates announced for main examinations UPSSSC has also announced tentative dates for several main examinations scheduled between June and September 2026. The examinations include recruitment for- The commission said the examinations and interviews will cover a wide range of vacancies across different state government departments. The release of the calendar is expected to provide clarity to thousands of candidates awaiting recruitment-related updates and help accelerate the appointment process for long-pending vacancies. stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:SP surveys aspirants ahead of 2027 UP Polls; Pahalgam attack probe reaches Pakistan more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day- 1. Pahalgam attack probe reaches Pakistan Terrorists’ mobile phones used in the Pahalgam attack have been traced to Karachi and Lahore, with investigators finding preloaded location data of the Baisaran area. The NIA says the findings point to possible Pakistani links in the case. 2. SP surveys aspirants ahead of 2027 UP Polls The Samajwadi Party has begun assessing potential candidates for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The survey aims to measure the ground strength and public support of ticket aspirants. 3. Akhilesh Yadav’s niece gets father’s portrait tattooed Padmaja, daughter of late Prateek Yadav, has paid tribute to her father by getting his portrait tattooed on her hand. The artwork depicts an emotional father-daughter embrace and has drawn attention on social media. 4. Expelled leaders hint at possible split in TMC Speculation of a split within the Trinamool Congress has intensified after expelled leader Riju Dutta claimed that over 50 MLAs may back a separate faction. The development could trigger fresh political turmoil in West Bengal. 5. Virat Kohli, Anushka visit Premanand Maharaj in Vrindavan Cricketer Virat Kohli and actor Anushka Sharma visited Premanand Maharaj’s ashram in Vrindavan after RCB’s IPL triumph. The couple sought blessings and walked barefoot into the ashram premises. 6. CEC Gyanesh Kumar offers prayers at Agra temple Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar visited Kailash Mahadev Temple in Agra with his family on Tuesday morning. He performed rituals, offered prayers and spent around 45 minutes at the temple. 7. Gold and Silver prices surge sharply Gold prices rose by ₹760, taking 24-carat gold to ₹1.56 lakh per 10 grams, while silver jumped ₹2,950 to ₹2.66 lakh per kg. The latest rates were released by the India Bullion and Jewellers Association. 8. Ghaziabad market remains shut after Surya murder Five days after Surya Chauhan’s murder, shops in Ghaziabad’s Khoda market remain closed in protest. The victim’s family continues to mourn, with his elder brother struggling to come to terms with the loss. 9. Property dealer shot dead inside SUV in Meerut A 23-year-old property dealer was shot dead inside his Scorpio vehicle in Meerut. After the murder, the attackers allegedly called his wife and told her to collect her husband’s body. 10. Salman Khan sends legal notice over ‘Kala Hiran’ film Actor Salman Khan has reportedly issued a legal notice against the makers of the upcoming film ‘Kala Hiran’. The notice seeks an immediate halt to the film’s production and promotional activities.

stories.title: CM attends over 200 people in Gorakhpur:Asks officials to maximise scheme outreach, offers jaggery-roti to cows
stories.summary: On Tuesday morning, CM Yogi arrived in Gorakhpur on a 3-day tour and listened to the problems of 200 people during ‘Janta Darshan’ at Gorakhnath Temple. He instructed officials to ensure that the benefits of government welfare schemes reach every needy person. There are schemes for every person in society, from housing, treatment, daughter's education, marriage to pensions for the destitute and elderly. During the public darshan, he assured the needy of providing benefits of housing and other schemes, and giving substantial financial assistance for treatment of those suffering from serious illnesses. He said that the government is committed to providing benefits of welfare schemes to every needy and eligible person and effective resolution of every problem. He asked people to definitely apply to avail the benefits of the schemes. Regarding this, he also directed officials to ensure that every eligible person applies for the relevant scheme and receives the benefits. After listening to the problems of people who came to the public hearing, CM Yogi referred the petitions to the concerned administrative and police officers for resolution and directed that all problems should be resolved in a time-bound, impartial and satisfactory manner. The Chief Minister asked the officers to show prompt sensitivity towards public problems. Like every time, this time too in the public hearing, some people came with a plea for financial help for treatment. The Chief Minister assured them that no one's treatment will be stopped due to lack of money. He instructed the officers that whoever is in need, the administration should quickly prepare and provide an estimate for their high-level treatment. As soon as the estimate is received, the government will immediately provide the funds. In the public hearing, a woman from Jaunpur district alleged that an NGO was issuing fake certificates and demanded an investigation against it. On this, the Chief Minister directed the officials to investigate the matter and take necessary action. Regarding complaints related to land encroachment, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has directed the police that if any strongman is forcibly occupying someone's land, strict action should be taken against them. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath showered affection and blessings on children who came with their families during the public audience. He also motivated them to study well and gave them chocolates. CM Yogi performed cow service at the temple's gaushala During his stay at Gorakhnath Temple, on Tuesday morning, along with serving the public through public audience, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath also went to the temple's gaushala and performed cow service. He caressed the cows, fed them jaggery and roti with his own hands, and gave instructions to the gaushala workers regarding the care of cattle.

stories.title: Man posing as IAS officer cheats woman of ₹6.5 lakh:Claims RAW agent status to gain trust, marriage promise
stories.summary: A married man in Uttar Pradesh's Gonda allegedly trapped a young woman by posing as an IAS officer and later claiming to be a RAW agent. He promised to marry her and assured her that he would secure government jobs for her two sisters. According to the complaint, the accused collected Rs 6.5 lakh from the family on the pretext of arranging jobs. When the promised jobs did not materialise, he allegedly changed his identity and began claiming that he worked as an agent for India's external intelligence agency, RAW. The woman alleged that the accused told her- After the Pahalgam attack, we have been called for a mission. I need to submit my marriage certificate. Therefore, we must get married immediately. Believing his claims, she married him. A few days later, the man reportedly left her on various pretexts and disappeared. When the woman's family became suspicious and began investigating, they allegedly found forged documents and a photograph of the accused with another woman identified as his wife. When confronted, he allegedly threatened to kill them before fleeing. The family has now lodged a complaint with police and demanded his arrest. Woman met accused at a party The case has been reported from the Dehat Kotwali area of Gonda. The woman said she lives with her mother and two sisters. Her father has passed away, and all three sisters had been searching for employment for a long time. She alleged that she first met the accused, Sandeep, at a party on December 17, 2024. The two remained in contact afterwards. According to the woman, Sandeep initially introduced himself as the Secretary of the Secondary Education Department and claimed to be an IAS officer. Later, he also claimed to be a RAW agent. She alleged that he lured her with promises of a government job and eventually provided her with a fake appointment letter. He later married her in April 2025. The woman further claimed that he collected Rs 6.5 lakh from her family, including money from both sisters, by promising government jobs. Fake appointment letter carried UP government seal According to the complaint, after taking documents and money from the family, Sandeep handed over an appointment letter bearing the seal of the Uttar Pradesh government at Ambedkar Chowk in Gonda on August 30, 2025. The letter stated that the woman had been appointed as a clerk at Khair Girls Inter College in Basti. However, when she reached the institution with the appointment letter, officials allegedly informed her that the document was completely fake and that no such appointment had been made. The woman said she again contacted Sandeep, who reassured her that he was an IAS officer and regularly helped people secure jobs. Promised jobs for both sisters The victim alleged that Sandeep promised to secure a clerk's job for her elder sister and a position in the Delhi Secretariat for her younger sister. However, neither sister received any job offer. The woman said- We were planning to have a grand wedding ceremony, but before that his truth came out. He used to take me out and made us spend all our money. He has caused us financial loss and mental distress. Strict action should be taken against him. Accused had already married twice The complainant is a BA graduate, while both her sisters are also graduates. Police said the accused, Sandeep, is a resident of Sikhri Auhri village in the Birno police station area of Ghazipur district. According to the complaint, he had already been married twice. One of his wives reportedly died of cancer. Police collecting evidence, search underway Circle Officer Anand Rai said the accused allegedly gained the woman's trust through deception and later extracted money from her by promising government employment. He added that several criminal cases had already been registered against the accused in Gonda and Ghazipur. The accused won the confidence of the young woman through fraud and then took money from her on the pretext of securing government jobs. Police are gathering evidence and efforts are underway to locate and arrest him. Police said further action will be taken based on the evidence collected during the investigation.

stories.title: 'Mafias and mosquitoes eliminated from UP':CM Yogi inaugurates ₹424 crore projects in Kushinagar; announces Fazilnagar to be renamed Pavagarh
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said in Kushinagar on Tuesday, "We have eliminated mafias and mosquitoes from Uttar Pradesh. Mosquitoes spread disease, while mafias create unemployment. The BrahMos missile, which is fired at Pakistan's chest, is now being manufactured in Lucknow. Whenever the missile is launched, Pakistan cries out, 'Save us, save us'." He further said- Previous governments produced crude bombs that were used to loot innocent people and traders. They compromised the safety of our daughters, but we have disciplined these hooligans. Those who did not listen to words eventually listened to bullets. The Chief Minister also announced that Fazilnagar would be renamed Pavagarh. Why should we call it Fazilnagar? By connecting this region with the legacy of Lord Mahavir, it will gain global recognition. During the programme, Yogi laid the foundation stone and inaugurated development projects worth Rs 424 crore. He also distributed certificates to beneficiaries of various government schemes. Ravi Kishan sings Bhojpuri songs at event Gorakhpur MP Ravi Kishan entertained the gathering by singing a Bhojpuri song, ‘ Takrar chidal ba ta sun lo, jhoote PDA waalon takrar chidal ba.’ He also sang in praise of the Chief Minister, 'Jaisan sochle rehni, waise Yogi ji mor baade, neta bejod baade ho. Yogi's 7 key points 1. Earlier, riots and lawlessness defined Uttar Pradesh Yogi said that under previous governments, Uttar Pradesh was known for the production of country-made pistols and crude bombs, whereas today the state is manufacturing BrahMos missiles for national security. He accused previous administrations of practising vote-bank politics, which he said harmed poor, deprived and Musahar communities the most. According to him, Kushinagar is now progressing on the path of development. He added that riots, crime and anarchy once defined the state, whereas security, development and welfare of the poor have now become its new identity. Without stopping, wavering or bowing, the government is ensuring that the benefits of welfare schemes reach the last person in society. 2. Samajwadi party has been openly Anti-Ram The Chief Minister said the construction of the Ram Temple in Ayodhya symbolised the victory of centuries of faith, struggle and determination. He said a foreign invader had demolished the temple at Lord Ram's birthplace 498 years ago, after which generations continued the struggle for its reconstruction. According to Yogi, although the movement continued for centuries, the temple project gained real momentum under the BJP's double-engine government. He also criticised Congress and the Samajwadi Party. Had Congress wanted to, it could have built the Ram Temple after Independence, but it did not. The Samajwadi Party has openly been anti-Ram and repeatedly created obstacles. However, our resolve remained firm. He said modern Ayodhya, with its development and spiritual grandeur, now evokes memories of the Treta Yuga. 3. Ram Temple and Article 370 were possible through the power of one vote Yogi said the impact of a single vote in a democracy can be seen from Ayodhya to Lucknow and Delhi. He stated that the public mandate enabled the construction of the Ram Temple and the abrogation of Article 370 in Jammu and Kashmir. The Chief Minister assured residents that Kushinagar would not face any shortage of funds for development. The double-engine government will meet the needs of every sector and ensure accountability for every penny spent. He said Kushinagar was never inherently backward but had suffered because of the flawed policies of previous governments, which led to disease, hunger and unemployment. According to him, the district is now progressing "at bullet speed" through improvements in education, healthcare, employment and infrastructure. Yogi also highlighted that sugarcane farmers are now receiving Rs 400 per quintal instead of Rs 315, while efforts are being made to ensure timely payments. 4. Previous policies led to corruption and disorder The Chief Minister said earlier governments left Uttar Pradesh trapped in corruption and mismanagement. He claimed that today, young people and women from Kushinagar are being selected for various government jobs, including police recruitment, while new investment is generating additional employment opportunities. Whenever recruitment takes place in Uttar Pradesh, I personally review the list to see whether any youth from Kushinagar have been selected. During the recent police recruitment drive, young people from Kushinagar also received appointments. 5. Previous governments left Kushinagar with disease and poverty Yogi alleged that the "distorted mindset" of earlier governments left Kushinagar struggling with disease, starvation and unemployment. He said the district had once suffered from the influence of mining mafias, exploitation of farmers, poor returns on agricultural produce, and weak healthcare and education systems. He also referred to reports of starvation deaths among members of the Musahar community in the Fazilnagar and Kasya areas. According to the Chief Minister, the double-engine government has tackled both encephalitis and organised crime, creating a new environment of development, security and employment. Kushinagar is no longer a symbol of backwardness. It is becoming a symbol of a new Uttar Pradesh moving ahead at bullet speed. 6. Tamkuhi Raj was once mocked, now it is developing Yogi said that before 2022, Tamkuhi Raj was often ridiculed and little attention was paid to the development of Fazilnagar. He credited the area's progress to cooperation between local representatives. Today I can say that the local MLA works hard to bring development schemes, while the MP also remains actively involved. Together they ensure that public demands are implemented on the ground. 7. Agricultural University to begin operations this session The Chief Minister said around 90,000 poor residents in the district have received housing benefits. At the same time, more than 3.14 lakh families have been provided toilets, free ration, health insurance under the Ayushman Bharat scheme and other welfare benefits. He noted that Kushinagar now has facilities once unimaginable, including a medical college, an international airport, a university, and an agricultural and technological university. The Agricultural University will begin functioning from this academic session itself, and admissions for students will start.

stories.title: Former SP leader accused of plotting property dealer's murder:Posed with Akhilesh Yadav, served as bypoll in-charge; owned fleet of luxury cars
stories.summary: Dinesh Yadav, the alleged mastermind behind the murder of Lucknow property dealer Sandeep Singh, was formerly the national vice-president of the Samajwadi Party's (SP) Lohia Vahini. He had also served as the party's in-charge during Assembly by-elections in 2020–21. Dinesh has shared photographs with SP chief Akhilesh Yadav on Facebook. His social media profile also features pictures from election campaigns and events with several senior SP leaders. Police said a car seized from his possession carried a board identifying him as the "National Vice-President of Lohia Vahini". Investigators added that he frequently used his political position to exert influence, including at police stations. Murder linked to long-running land dispute Sandeep Singh was shot dead by bike-borne assailants in the PGI police station area on May 27. Multiple police and STF teams were deployed to investigate the case. The probe revealed that the murder stemmed from an old land dispute. Sandeep, originally from Jaunpur, worked as a property dealer in Lucknow. Police have arrested Dinesh Yadav and his driver, Mukarrabin, in connection with the case. Four luxury vehicles belonging to Dinesh, including a Mercedes, have also been seized. The two shooters, who allegedly carried out the killing for a contract worth Rs 5 lakh, remain absconding. SP says Dinesh was no longer active in party work Responding to the case, SP national spokesperson Fakhrul Hasan Chand said- Dinesh Yadav was formerly the National Vice-President of Samajwadi Lohia Vahini, a youth organisation. At present, he was engaged in his own work and was not active in party activities. 4 Photos- 'He used political influence to intimidate people' Local residents, speaking on condition of anonymity, alleged that Dinesh often used his political connections to intimidate people. According to them, he would pressure others by flaunting his position and would allegedly seize land of his choice. Anyone who objected was reportedly silenced through his political influence. Served as party in-charge in several by-elections Dinesh Yadav, also known as Deva, is a resident of Samda village in the Alapur Assembly constituency and is said to have been close to Akhilesh Yadav. He began his political career at Lucknow University around two decades ago and later held leadership roles in the Lohia Vahini at the state level. The party also appointed him national vice-president of its student wing, Chhatra Sabha. Dinesh additionally served as the party's in-charge during by-elections in Mainpuri, Azamgarh and Gorakhpur. What the accused told the STF Murder plot hatched over ongoing dispute Investigators have found that Dinesh and the deceased, Sandeep Singh, were involved in a dispute over land in Kakori. During questioning, Mukarrabin told STF officials that he had worked as Dinesh's driver since 2016. He claimed Dinesh was under constant pressure due to legal cases and complaints and had said that Sandeep "needed to be removed". According to investigators, the two then conspired to arrange a contract killing. Shooters hired for Rs 5 lakh STF interrogation revealed that Mukarrabin contacted the shooters through his network. The murder contract was reportedly finalised for around Rs 5 lakh. The two shooters were brought to Lucknow, where arrangements were made for their accommodation and transport. They allegedly tracked Sandeep's movements and daily routes for several days before the attack. Fake number plate used for surveillance Investigating agencies said a second-hand Apache motorcycle was purchased specifically for the crime. The original registration plate was removed and replaced with a fake one. The shooters allegedly used the bike to conduct repeated reconnaissance and familiarise themselves with Sandeep's movements and routine. Accused left Lucknow on day of murder Investigators have also found that Dinesh and Mukarrabin left Lucknow on the day of the murder in an attempt to avoid suspicion. Police said the shooters carried out the killing during the day and later informed the accused by phone that the operation had been completed. Officials maintain that the absconding shooters will be arrested soon. CCTV footage captured the attack Dainik Bhaskar had obtained exclusive CCTV footage of the incident. The 50-second clip showed Sandeep stepping out of his car and walking ahead while speaking on his mobile phone. A gunman wearing a white shirt and blue jeans then approached him and opened fire. The first bullet struck Sandeep near the chest, causing him to collapse on the road. The attacker continued firing even after he fell. The final shot reportedly struck him near the head.

stories.title: Actor seeks blessings from Ganga for Chand Mera Dil's success:Lakshya reaches Varanasi, says, 'I feel happy to come to Kashi'
stories.summary: Actor Lakshya Lalwani arrived in Varanasi to seek blessings for the success of his upcoming film 'Chand Mera Dil'. During his visit, he took part in the grand Ganga Aarti held at the globally renowned Dashashwamedh Ghat, where he was seen sitting among devotees and witnessing the spiritual ceremony. Lakshya gained widespread recognition for playing the lead role in the television serial 'Porus'. He made his big-screen debut in 2023 and is currently making headlines for his upcoming film 'Chand Mera Dil'. During his stay in Varanasi, Lakshya also explored the historic lanes of Kashi and experienced the city's rich cultural and spiritual traditions up close. He reached the temple city on Monday and left on Tuesday morning. ‘Got peace of mind’ Lakshya performed Ganga puja with his companions according to rituals and experienced the divine atmosphere of the aarti. He said that he had previously seen the Ganga aarti only in videos, but experiencing it in person was extremely wonderful and spiritual. He said, "Watching the aarti brought peace to my mind. The atmosphere here and the feeling of devotion gives great comfort to the mind. I am very happy to see the aarti from close up." Lakshya's career has been on high note It is noteworthy that Lakshya Lalwani is an emerging actor in the Indian film and television industry. He started his acting career in 2015 with the TV show 'Warrior High'. After this, he gained popularity by acting in serials like 'Adhuri Kahani Hamari', 'Pyaar Tune Kya Kiya' and 'Pardes Mein Hai Mera Dil'. First film in 2023 was 'Kill' Lakshya gained the most recognition for playing the lead role in the historical TV series 'Porus' (2017-18). After that, he stepped into the film world. He made his Bollywood debut as a hero with the action film 'Kill' released in 2023, for which he also received the Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut Actor. Currently, Lakshya is in the news for his upcoming film 'Chand Mera Dil' and to seek blessings for its success, he reached Kashi and took the blessings of Mother Ganga.

stories.title: Devoleena Bhattacharjee furious over Surya murder case:Actress says ‘Terrorism must be eradicated from its roots’
stories.summary: TV actress Devoleena Bhattacharjee has given a strong reaction regarding the Surya Chauhan murder case that took place in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. On social platform X, Devoleena wrote, 'It is very important to eradicate this terrorism. Those with cheap thinking, cheap upbringing, and cheap values, including their parents, should all be hanged.' The actress further wrote, 'Yogi Adityanath, if there is any biggest punishment for the rarest of rare cases, then all of them, including their families, should receive it.' Meanwhile, CM Yogi Adityanath said on Monday in Bijnor regarding the Surya murder case that recently in Ghaziabad, a stabbing occurred under the guise of friendship. This is absolutely unacceptable. If someone is unable to control their wayward child, then understand that they are making a mistake. Surya Chauhan stabbed to death On May 28, on the day of Eid al-Adha, in Ghaziabad's Khoda area, 11th-grade student Surya Chauhan (17 years old) was stabbed to death. On Sunday (May 31) morning, Asad, the main accused in the case, was killed in a police encounter. Police have arrested 3 accused, including Asad's father Nawab, on charges of conspiracy. The fifth accused is still absconding. Now a bulldozer will run on the house of accused Asad. On Monday, the administration team reached Asad's house. The gate of the house was locked. After this, the SDM pasted a notice on the door for building a house by illegal encroachment. It was stated that the land on which the house is built has been illegally encroached upon. Asad's father, Nawab, will have to submit his reply to the SDM office within 15 days. He has also been asked to remove the illegal encroachment himself.
